title: Shared Money and currency contract
description: ENG-01 new contract. Source: SA 08.1 (bigint minor units; currency/precision not assumed) 與 SD authorization-and-approval.md §3.1 (decimal integer string, no float) 與 SD credit-and-refund.md §2. 本檔固定跨 ENG-02/07/08 共用的金額型別，不核定任何商家費率或額度。

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code. Precision/decimal places are NOT assumed to be 2; see CurrencyScaleRef.

CurrencyScaleRef.description: Reference to the versioned currency/connector configuration that defines minor-unit scale for a currency (SD credit-and-refund.md §2: 'not all currencies are two decimals'). Not a literal decimal count, because scale is a configured, versioned fact, not a constant baked into this schema.

MinorUnitsAmount.description: Non-negative integer amount in the currency's minor unit, carried as a decimal string to avoid cross-language integer precision loss for large values (SD authorization-and-approval.md §3.1). No sign, no leading zero, no decimal point.

SignedMinorUnitsAmount.description: Same encoding as MinorUnitsAmount but permits a leading '-' for ledger entries that must express direction explicitly in computation (e.g. reconciliation deltas). Domain ledgers still record entry_type rather than relying on sign alone (SD credit-and-refund.md §6.2).

Money.description: A single currency amount. Two Money values with different currency codes are never summed directly (SD credit-and-refund.md §2).

NamedRatio.description: A proportion expressed as named numerator/denominator or an exact decimal string; float is prohibited (SD authorization-and-approval.md §3.1). Exactly one representation per instance.
